Celebrity Traitors Cast Faces Scrutiny Over Leaks and Rule-Breaking

The BBC is reportedly struggling to manage the cast of its show "Celebrity Traitors" due to incidents of leaks, spoilers, and rule-breaking. One participant, James Acaster, was reportedly "told off by BBC bosses" after making a phone call. Another star described the producers as being "like human traffickers" after being denied a phone call.
